say:1:1330812001:1.text: Because... I'm just curious about what it's like to be ordinary!
say:1:1330812001:1.source_cn: 因为……因为我想体验当一个普通烛台的感觉是什么样的！
say:1:1330812001:1.male: Because... I'm just curious about what it's like to be ordinary!
say:1:1330812001:1.female: Because... I'm just curious about what it's like to be ordinary!

say:2:1330812002:1.text: Alright, I'll come clean—I accidentally damaged Lord Ludovic's painting... By pretending to be an ordinary candelabra, he won't realize it was me!
say:2:1330812002:1.source_cn: 好吧，其实是我不小心搞坏了主人的画……如果我假装成普通...
say:2:1330812002:1.male: Alright, I'll come clean—I accidentally damaged Lord Ludovic's painting... By pretending to be an ordinary candelabra, he won't realize it was me!
say:2:1330812002:1.female: Alright, I'll come clean—I accidentally damaged Lord Ludovic's painting... By pretending to be an ordinary candelabra, he won't realize it was me!
